support.note: Core materializes the documented ground-only direct splash and delayed ground-only destruction explosion through serialised projectile/death-effect state. Viewer, Headless and RL observe this shared Core state; projectile trajectory, collision, target selection and exact tick order remain partial.

known_uncertainties: No consulted public source supplies a current full level table with an immutable live-client identifier.
Projectile trajectory, speed, collision width, target-loss and retarget timing are not reproducibly documented.
The direct-splash and destruction-radius boundary inclusivity, exact target selection and same-tick ordering are not published.
conclusion: Bomb Tower L1-L13 has a shared-Core ground-only splash and one-second delayed ground-only death-explosion baseline, with official historical level corroboration and dated secondary mechanics evidence; lifecycle and client geometry remain partial.
